question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 用手把靜止的書箱往前推動，主要施力屬於？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 推是沿施力方向把物體推離自己。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 彈簧被拉長後想恢復原狀，對手產生的力較接近？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 形變回復產生的力為彈力。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 物體在桌面上慢慢停下來，與哪一種力最有關？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 接觸面間的摩擦力會阻礙運動。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.commonMisconception: 誤以為停下來只因為「地球吸住」。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 磁鐵最能吸引下列哪一種？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 常見強磁性材料以鐵鈷鎳為主。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.commonMisconception: 誤以為所有金屬都被吸引。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 彈簧秤讀到的「公克重」主要在描述？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 此處以重量對應的力來表示大小。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 在小幅擺動下，改變擺錘重量，週期通常？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 理想單擺週期與擺長有關，與質量無關。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.commonMisconception: 直覺誤以為越重擺越快。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 探究擺長與週期關係時，應固定？
options: 擺動角度與擺錘形狀一致
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 一次只改擺長，其他條件盡量固定。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.commonMisconception: 同時改多個變因導致結論無效。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 擺線變長時，來回擺動一次的時間通常？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 擺長越長，週期越長。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 同一物體在毛巾表面比玻璃表面難拉動，主要因？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 粗糙面摩擦力較大。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 同樣大小的力，拉門把手的方向不同，開門效果可能不同，說明？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 力是向量，方向影響轉動效果。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 蘋果從樹上落下，主要是受到？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 地球對物體的引力使其向下加速。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.commonMisconception: 以為落下是因為「沒有支撐」。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 下列哪一組都是「接觸力」的例子？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 推、摩擦都需接觸（巨觀層級教學）。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.commonMisconception: 把非接觸磁力與接觸力混在同一組。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 測量前指針未在零點，直接讀值會造成？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 需先歸零或校正，否則讀值偏差。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 使用彈簧秤拉動物體，為何要避免瞬間猛拉？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 猛拉可能超過量程或造成危險。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 在光滑冰面上冰壺滑得較遠，相較粗糙地面，主要差異是？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 低摩擦使物體較不易減速。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.commonMisconception: 誤以為冰面讓重力消失。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 衛生紙邊緣浸入水中，水往上爬，稱為？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 水沿細小孔隙上升。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.commonMisconception: 與連通管液面等高混淆。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 光滑塑膠片浸入水中，水幾乎不沿片上移，原因接近？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 毛細需要可滲水的微細通道。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.commonMisconception: 誤以為所有固體都能毛細。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 形狀不同的底部相通容器，靜止後水面？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 連通管原理：同液體靜止液面等高。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 連通管水面等高概念，可用來協助理解？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 利用液面等高判斷水平。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.commonMisconception: 不知道連通管與水平的關係。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 虹吸時水能越過拱形高點，主要靠什麼驅動？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 整體仍由重力造成壓差，出口要低。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.commonMisconception: 誤以為水主動爬坡不需重力。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 冰飲料杯外壁小水珠，主要是因為？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 水蒸氣遇冷表面凝結成水滴。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 茶壺壺嘴與壺身水面等高，屬於？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 底部連通、液面等高典型例。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 相同液體中，細管通常比粗管毛細上升？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 管徑越細，毛細效果越顯著。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.commonMisconception: 直覺以為粗管吸得多升得高。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 熱水澡後鏡子起霧，小水滴主要來自？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 溫差造成鏡面凝結。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.commonMisconception: 不知道水蒸氣來源是空氣。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 用軟管換水前先灌水排氣，與哪現象有關？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 需連續水柱加高低差。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.commonMisconception: 誤以為只要管子碰到水就會流。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 比較不同材質吸水，應控制？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 控制變因才能比較材質。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 「水沿衛生紙纖維上升」與「底部相通液面等高」分別是？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 正確配對名詞與現象。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 虹吸水流中斷，首先應檢查？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 氣泡破壞連續水柱。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 水蒸氣遇冷變成小水滴，稱為？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 氣態轉液態為凝結。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 自動澆水器利用軟管跨越盆緣引水，概念上結合？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 多為虹吸配合高低差。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 地震發生時，室內初步自我保護口訣常提到？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: DCH 降低跌倒與飛物受傷風險。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.commonMisconception: 誤以為一定要衝出建築物。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 地震能量釋放與下列何者最有關？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 岩層受力錯動累積能量後釋放。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.commonMisconception: 擬人化以為地底怪獸在動。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 岩漿噴出地表後，常稱為？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 流出地表的岩漿稱熔岩。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 砂岩層理明顯，較可能屬於？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 沉積物堆積壓實形成沉積岩。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 花崗岩與玄武岩主要與哪過程有關？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 火成岩由岩漿冷卻形成。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.commonMisconception: 誤以為所有岩石都是泥巴變的。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 登山時聞到硫黃味、見冒煙噴氣，應提高警覺何種地形？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 火山地區常伴隨氣體與熱活動。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 岩石在原地碎裂變小，主要稱？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 風化強調原地崩解。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.commonMisconception: 把風化與搬運的侵蝕混淆。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 河水把泥沙搬到下游堆積，屬於？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 流水具侵蝕、搬運、堆積能力。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.commonMisconception: 誤以為河流只會沖刷不會堆積。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 大理岩常由石灰岩經高溫高壓變質，說明變質岩與何者相關？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 變質作用改變岩石組織與礦物。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 震央指的是？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 震央是震源垂直投影到地表的位置。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 粉筆泡水冷凍反覆，出現裂痕，主要模擬？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 模擬水結冰膨脹對裂隙的破壞。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.commonMisconception: 誤以為只是粉筆品質差。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 河谷切割加深往往需要？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 地形變化多屬長期累積。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 台灣本島可觀察到地震與部分火山活動，主因與何者有關？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 板塊邊界地質活動較活躍。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 岩層中發現貝殼化石，較支持？
options: 完全由火山灰瞬間形成
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 化石多保存在沉積岩中。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.commonMisconception: 誤把化石當火成岩必備。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 地震時若在高樓層，不當的做法是？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 地震時電梯危險，應避免使用。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.commonMisconception: 誤以為電梯最快最安全。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 要讓小燈泡穩定發光，電路通常需要？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 電流需完整路徑才能持續流通。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.commonMisconception: 誤以為碰一下電池就會亮。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 兩顆燈泡串聯後，與單顆相比，亮度通常？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 串聯分壓使通過電流變小，燈較暗。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 兩顆燈泡並聯，其中一顆燒壞，另一顆？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 並聯各有路徑，另一路仍可通。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 兩條導線直接把電池正負極相接且未經燈泡，可能造成？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 短路電流大，電池易過熱。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 下列何者較可能是導體？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 金屬通常易導電。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.commonMisconception: 誤以為所有硬物都導電。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 電線外皮常用塑膠包覆，主要目的？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 絕緣避免觸電與短路。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 開關在電路中的主要功能是？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 開關切斷或接通迴路。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 電池正負極裝反，常導致？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 極性錯誤可能無法驅動電路。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.commonMisconception: 強行反裝可能損壞器材。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 下列何者較屬可再生能源？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 太陽能在人類尺度可持續利用。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 隨手關燈與減少待機電器，主要在減少？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 降低用電需求與相關排放。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.commonMisconception: 不知道日常行為與能源關聯。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 最簡單電路常包含電源、導線與？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 需有消耗電能的元件完成迴路功能。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 聖誕燈串一顆燈壞全滅，較像？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 串聯單一路徑，斷一處全斷。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 燈不亮時，第一步較合理的檢查是？
options: 確認迴路是否閉合與接觸良好
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 先查斷路、鬆脫、極性與電量。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 石油與煤相對風力，較常被歸類為？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 化石燃料形成緩慢，屬不可再生。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.question: 濕手觸摸插頭較危險，與何者最有關？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.explanation: 雜質水可導電，增加觸電風險。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/HanLin/G.commonMisconception: 低估水與電的危險組合。
